page.overview:
Who is Argenta?

Hall Matron Argenta is the fifth Frontier Brain in the Sinnoh and Johto regions. She is in charge of the Battle Hall.

Argenta is a classy and fashionable old woman with fair skin, purple hair, and red eyes. She wears a white turtleneck, a red jacket with gray rings, and long red shorts with a black Poké Ball symbol, along with purple tights and long black boots with tall white heels. To complete her outfit, she wears black gloves, red-framed sunglasses, and circular blue earrings, pairing them all with purple lipstick.

In the game, the player character will battle her first during the 50th battle. Like Thorton, her Pokémon team is random, though they almost always have high stats. Her first move is usually a stat-raising move, or a special condition move. It usually takes 2 hits to defeat her, since you'll most likely not have a type-effective attack. This is a 1 vs 1 battle, so it is vital to get the first attack. Upon beating her, the player character gain the silver print and 20 BP. In the rematch, she can be fought will at battle 170. Her Pokémon tends to be a deity type.
